title: 🇵🇭 Philippine Spam/ Scam SMS by BwandoWando
description: This dataset contains SMS messages whose contents are considered to be spam and/or scams. The messages were collected from January 23, 2018 to August 27, 2025 and include sender info, timestamps, and message content.
author: BwandoWando (2024)

title: Tagalog-SMS by zero
description: This dataset contains SMS messages received by the author from April 30, 2024 to April 13, 2025. The messages are categorized as spam, advertisements, government messages, notifications, and OTPs (one-time passwords).
author: zero (2023)

title: 🇵🇭 PH Spam + Marketing SMS by Scott Lee Chua
description: This dataset contains SMS messages received by the author from September 30, 2022 to June 24, 2025. Messages are categorized as spam, advertisements, government notifications, and OTPs.
author: Scott Lee Chua (2023)
